PREFACE.

This list comprises the names of all plants, arranged alphabetically under the families to which they belong, growing in the Botanic Gardens. For the benefit of planters the common names, habit, and economic value of the plants are given.

Seeds of plants available for exchange with other institutions and individuals are preceded by an asterisk.

The following abbreviations are used in the third column to indicate the habit of the plant, thus: A.—Annual, C.—Climber, E.—Epiphyte, P.—Perennial, Pe.—Parasite, S.—Shrub, S.T.—Shrubby Tree, T.—Tree.

This list will not be re-published annually, so it is hoped that recipients will retain it for future reference.

A. E. EVANS,
Ag. Director of Agriculture.
